explained.summary: Think about the kind of people we try to impress, what we hope to gain from them, and what we do to win their approval. Then think how quickly time will bury all of it, and how much it has buried already. Seen this way, chasing people’s good opinion looks a poor use of a life.
explained.today: Consider who you’re really dressing for, posting for or staying late to impress, and what you’d actually get. In a few years most of those people won’t remember, and the moment will be long gone.
